inspectionScope: Targeted read-only inspection of current supplied Warrior engine, relevant cards, historical tree excerpts and final shared/HM decisions; not repeat review of the full feat archive.

engineExcerpts.2: MUTATION SLOTS. At Warrior 1 you have one mutation slot; slot II unlocks at Warrior 5, slot III at Warrior 13 and slot IV at Warrior 20. During a completed short or long rest, equip one eligible mutation in each slot. Equipped mutations are dormant until activated unless their text explicitly says otherwise. You cannot equip the same named mutation twice.
engineExcerpts.3: ACTIVE MUTATIONS. Before Juggernaut Mutation Efficiency, only one equipped mutation can be active at a time. Mutation Efficiency raises the ordinary simultaneous-active limit to two. Transcendent, Apex Form and other explicit features can temporarily exceed that limit. Activating a mutation beyond the current limit ends one active mutation of your choice unless an explicit exception permits otherwise.
engineExcerpts.8: BRUTALITY PROGRESS. Begin each real encounter with Brutality Progress 0 and BT 0. Add actual damage you personally deal to meaningful hostile creatures to Brutality Progress, but a single damage event contributes no more than one-quarter of your maximum HP. Crossing cumulative thresholds equal to 25%, 50% and 75% of your maximum HP grants 1 BT each, subject to the BT cap. Crossing 100% triggers Transcendent as described below but does not create a fourth stored BT unless Stack Overflow or another feature raises the cap.
engineExcerpts.11: BRUTALITY STATES. At BT 1 you are Awakened; at BT 2 Primed; at BT 3 Unleashed. At Warrior 12+, reaching BT 4 or crossing 100% Brutality Progress may trigger the same once-per-encounter Transcendent pulse, even if your stored cap remains 3; it is never an indefinitely active state. State benefits are defined as operational extra Cards and vanish immediately if spending BT drops you below their thresholds.
engineExcerpts.17: MUTATION TIERS. Basic mutations require Warrior 1. Advanced mutations require Warrior 6. Apex mutations require Warrior 15. You may equip any mutation whose level gate and other prerequisite you meet. Each tree permits any number of Basic mutations up to slot limits, at most two equipped Advanced mutations at once, and at most one equipped Apex mutation at once.
engineExcerpts.18: MUTATION FEATS. Mutation feats are not free mutation selections. They become eligible choices at an ASI/feat opportunity or other campaign feat grant once their listed level and mutation prerequisite are met. They do not consume mutation slots unless their own text says otherwise.
engineExcerpts.19: HERO MUTATION TREES. Bulwark Mutation Tree, Gore Mutation Tree and Aberrant Mutation Tree are Hero cards that unlock their associated Hero-specific mutation extra Cards. Those mutations still occupy normal mutation slots and obey active-mutation, serum and Strain rules.
engineExcerpts.22: SOURCE PROGRESSION RECONCILIATION. Book progression grants Mutation Slot II at 5, Bone Hardened at 6, Serum Overclock at 9, Mutation Slot III at 13, Brutal Adaptation at 15, Reflexive Mutation at 17 and Apex Form at 20 automatically. Registry-only Fighting Style, Second Wind, Action Surge, Extra Attack and draft level features are preserved in excluded Registry Alternatives and original source evidence. They are not acquired or stacked onto this playtest schedule.
engineExcerpts.23: All class gates use Warrior class level, not total character level. Proficiency bonus follows the game's ordinary total-character-level rule. No other class level unlocks Warrior mutation tiers, serum capacity, Juggernaut, Hero paths, Apex mutations or Final Forms.

record.name: Mutation Efficiency
record.effect: Mutation Efficiency. You may maintain up to two equipped mutations active simultaneously instead of one. Activating a third mutation while two are already active requires choosing one active mutation to become dormant unless another explicit feature temporarily raises this limit. Mutation slots, serum costs, Strain and mutation durations remain unchanged.

source.originalText: Mutation Efficiency: May have 2 active mutations at once (Lv 3)

record.name: Apex Form
record.effect: Gain mutation slot IV permanently. When Apex Form activates, all equipped mutations become active for 3 rounds without consuming serum doses and ignore the normal active-mutation concurrency limit. Serum-profile effects are not granted. When the form ends, choose active mutations up to your normal limit; all others become dormant.

source.originalText: | 20 | Apex Form – Gain a permanent 4th mutation & unleash once/encounter ultimate form |

record.name: Transcendent
record.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
record.effect: At Warrior 12+, the first time this encounter you cross 100% Brutality Progress or reach stored BT 4, activate all equipped mutations until start of your next regular turn. No serum profile or immediate healing trigger is granted. This is one total pulse, never a permanent BT 4 concurrency increase. At end choose active mutations up to normal limit, with their original remaining durations; others become dormant.
record.prerequisite: Warrior 12; 100% Brutality Progress or BT 4 with raised cap; new explicit level gate

source.originalText: | Transcendent | Deal 100% of max HP as damage | All mutations active simultaneously for 1 round |

record.name: Mythic Carapace
record.duration: Until encounter ends, mutation ends or you fall below one-quarter maximum HP
record.effect: Gain DR 3 against all damage and immunity to Bleed, Poisoned and Burn-style ongoing fire effects. Once per encounter when one hit deals more than 20 actual damage after mitigation, gain 1 BT and refresh the remaining duration of your other active mutations to 3 rounds. It grants no serum-profile refresh.
record.prerequisite: Warrior 15; Apex Vital; maximum one Apex equipped

source.originalText:
| Mythic Carapace | While this is active:
- +3 DR flat
- Immune to Bleed, Poison, and Burn
- Once per combat, when you're struck for more than 20 damage: immediately gain +1 BT and refresh all active mutations
- Lasts until the end of combat or you fall below 25% HP |

record.name: Butcherform Chassis
record.duration: 3 rounds or until below one-quarter maximum HP
record.effect: When you take the ordinary Attack action, make one additional melee attack beyond other Extra Attack effects, respecting the one-additional-full-Action guard because this is part of the same Action. Your melee criticals add one extra weapon damage die beyond normal critical dice, not triple total damage. Once per round when you personally kill a meaningful hostile with a melee attack, restore one consumed prepared serum dose, never above reserve capacity.
record.prerequisite: Warrior 15; Apex Combat; maximum one Apex equipped

source.originalText:
| Butcherform Chassis | While active:
- Gain +2 attacks per round
- Crits deal triple damage
- Melee kills instantly refresh 1 serum or 1 mutation use
- Lasts for 3 rounds or until you're below 25% HP |

record.name: Voidbirth Shell
record.effect: You may move through enemy spaces and nonmagical difficult terrain without extra cost but cannot end inside a creature or solid object. Enemies within 15 feet take -1 on attack rolls and morale. At the end of each of your turns create one 1-HP clone in an adjacent legal space, maximum 2 clones. A clone cannot attack or block movement; when destroyed it explodes, creatures within 5 feet make Dexterity saves taking 2d6 psychic on failure or half on success. Clones grant no resources, corpses, XP or BT.
record.prerequisite: Warrior 15; Apex Aberrant; maximum one Apex equipped

source.originalText:
| Voidbirth Shell | While active:
- Gain Ethereal Movement (ignore terrain, move through enemies)
- Enemies within 3 tiles have –2 morale and suffer Weakened
- Each turn, summon 1 temporary clone (1 HP, explodes on death for 2d6 psychic)
- Lasts 3 rounds or until all clones are expended |

record.name: Living Fortress
record.frequency: While at least three Vital mutations are active
record.effect: You cannot grant advantage to an enemy solely because it is flanking you. Other sources of advantage still apply.
record.prerequisite: Warrior 8; three Vital mutations equipped; eligible feat grant

source.originalText: | Living Fortress | 3 Vital Mutations active | Gain immunity to flanking |
